New Zealand came back even harder with the ball. They simply ran through the Pakistani batting line-up as a result, the visitors have already lost half their side. Southee got the early three wickets and then Wagner got two in two later on. Babar Azam is battling out for Pakistan along with Sarfraz Ahmed and Pakistan need a big partnership tomorrow as they still trail by 195 runs. Due to lack of television feed there won't be commentary available for this match. Let's see what do we have in store tomorrow, join us back then. Goodbye and take care. Cheers!

What a day for New Zealand! They're completely on top here after stumps on day 2. Early on, their batters took their total past the 250-run mark with useful contributions from Grandhomme, Watling and Raval who hit a fifty. Southee added some quick runs in the end as well for the hosts. Sohail Khan finished with four wickets while Imran Khan grabbed three. Mohammad Amir managed two wickets but let's not forget the catches dropped off his bowling. Pakistan could have done better with the ball though.
